title: Can you guys help testing my game? Its a little rough
author: Swimming_Ask3859
selftext: I have been developing a drone racing game, and I just finished with the first map (little rough edges) and the physics of the flying, along with the design of the first done. I aim for it to be a 4-8 person multiplayer race, with bots filling in places, and a solo race where you go through gates and time yourself. I aim to have different maps, weapons (currently only laser), different vehicles, and a lot more capabilities but I was just wondering if you could play it, see what you like/what you dont like, and recommend any improvements! I appreciate any feed back (first time developer). Here! [https://redline.rainymorel7.chatgpt.site/](https://redline.rainymorel7.chatgpt.site/). I used a mix fo chatgpt and claude to make it, with sonnet doing the initial environment, chatgpt generating the drone model, and chatgpt refinining the physics and shade and waterfall.
